meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 装上此技能后,Claude 能帮你读、查、改 BIDS 格式的脑科学/生物医学数据集:按被试、任务等条件找文件,检查是否符合 BIDS 规范,把 DICOM 转成 BIDS,并编写配套的 JSON 元数据文件。
howto.when: 当你提到要整理或查询 BIDS 数据、验证数据集合规性、把 DICOM 转成 BIDS 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这批 DICOM 文件转成 BIDS 格式。
say.note: 会调用转换流程生成 BIDS 目录。

say.text: 用 PyBIDS 查一下这个数据集里所有 bold 文件。
say.note: 返回匹配的文件列表和元数据。

say.text: 帮我验证这个数据集是否符合 BIDS 规范。
say.note: 运行验证器并给出错误报告。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to read, query, and modify BIDS-formatted neuroscience/biomedical datasets: finding files by subject or task, checking BIDS compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, and writing JSON sidecar metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to organize or query BIDS data, validate compliance, or convert DICOM to BIDS.

say_en.text: Convert this batch of DICOM files to BIDS.
say_en.note: Runs conversion and creates a BIDS layout.

say_en.text: Use PyBIDS to list all bold files in this dataset.
say_en.note: Returns matching file list and metadata.

say_en.text: Check this dataset for BIDS compliance.
say_en.note: Runs the validator and reports issues.
